message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the correct crime label(s) based on the facts. The facts: a public servant (state employee) who as a social security employee misappropriated pension contributions (public funds) of employees, 1,332,700 RMB, used to purchase a bank financial product, earned interest 4,739.64 RMB, which was seized. He returned principal, interest seized. He turned himself in, self-report. The prosecution says: "挪用公款归个人使用，进行营利活动，数额较大" => crime: "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds). Possibly also "挪用资金" but they differentiate. The example: first case: "挪用公司货款" => answer "挪用资金". That is for private company. For public funds, they use "挪用公款". So answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>
